parameters.name: type

RequestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which is used to locate and troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题

TargetList.description_en: An array that consists of the details of the configuration items
TargetList.description_zh: 目标开关的配置信息列表

items.description_en: The details of the configuration item

Flag.description_en:
The mode in which the configuration takes effect. Valid values:

add: In this mode, the configuration takes effect on the assets.
del: In this mode, the configuration does not take effect on the assets
Flag.description_zh:
配置生效类型。取值：

add：包含
del：排除

Target.description_en:
The ID of the asset on which the configuration takes effect.



When you set the TargetType parameter to uuid, the value of this parameter indicates the UUID of an asset.

When you set the TargetType parameter to Cluster, the value of this parameter indicates the ID of a cluster.

When you set the TargetType parameter to image_repo, the value of this parameter indicates the ID of an image repository
Target.description_zh:
目标开关的配置的操作值。
TargetType取值为 uuid时，该值表示资产UUID。
TargetType取值为Cluster时，该值表示集群ID。
TargetType取值为image_repo时，该值表示镜像仓库ID

TargetType.description_en:
The dimension from on which the feature was configured. Valid values:

uuid: the UUID of the asset
Cluster: the ID of the cluster
image_repo: the ID of the image repository
TargetType.description_zh:
目标开关的配置的操作维度。取值：

uuid：资产UUID
Cluster：集群ID
image_repo：镜像仓ID
